meta.name: lsp-setup
meta.description: Configures a language server so editor/agent tooling (diagnostics, go-to-definition, references, rename) works. Use when a project needs an LSP installed or wired, or a 'no LSP server configured' error appears.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 配置语言服务器，让编辑器自动提供代码检查与跳转功能。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写代码时遇到未配置语言服务器的提示，导致编辑器没有代码检查与跳转。
copy.tagline_en: Configure a language server to enable code diagnostics and navigation in your editor.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your editor keeps saying no language server is configured when you code.

howto.what: Claude 会扫描项目识别所用编程语言，安装并配置对应的语言服务器（LSP），再实际跑一次诊断来确认配置成功，让编辑器的诊断、跳转定义等功能可用。
howto.when: 当用户要求为项目安装或接通 LSP，或出现“未配置语言服务器”的报错时触发。Claude 会根据文件扩展名识别语言并执行配置流程。

say.text: 为这个 Python 项目配置语言服务器并验证诊断正常。
say.note: Claude 会按 Python 流程检测、安装并运行验证。

say.text: 帮我设置 Rust 项目的 rust-analyzer，让跳转定义可用。
say.note: 会安装 rust-analyzer 并写入配置。

say.text: 我收到“LSP 服务器未配置”错误，帮我处理这个 Go 文件。
say.note: Claude 会检测文件类型并配置对应服务器。

howto.what_en: Claude scans the project to identify languages, installs and configures the matching language server, then runs a real diagnostics roundtrip to confirm the setup, enabling editor features like diagnostics and go-to-definition.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to install or wire an LSP for a project, or when a 'no LSP server configured' error appears. Claude detects the language by file extension and runs the setup workflow.

say_en.text: Set up the language server for this Python project and verify diagnostics.
say_en.note: It will detect, install, and run verification.

say_en.text: Set up rust-analyzer for my Rust project so go-to-definition works.
say_en.note: It will install the server and write config.

say_en.text: I got a 'no LSP server configured' error, please fix it for this Go file.
say_en.note: It will detect the language and configure the server.
